codes.C08_EXPLANATION_NOT_DECISION_AUTHORITY: This explanation has no decision, candidate, scoring, or recommendation authority.
codes.C08_LLM_FALLBACK_USED: The provider result was unavailable or rejected; deterministic packet-only fallback was used.
codes.C08_LLM_SEMANTIC_NOT_BYTE_DETERMINISTIC: Accepted LLM wording is semantically bounded but is not byte-deterministic.
codes.C08_NO_CAUSAL_UPGRADE: The explanation must not strengthen association or uncertainty into causal truth.
codes.C08_NO_OPERATIONAL_ACTION_AUTHORITY: This explanation grants no authority to execute or mutate operational state.
codes.C08_SIMULATION_NOT_OPERATIONAL_EFFICACY: Simulation output is a modeled comparison and does not establish real-world intervention efficacy.
